item.title: Caucus Award 2019
item.description: We want to congratulate Kelly Pike! Kelly was the winner of the 2019 Caucus foundation for a $30,000 post production grant from us here at illuminate Hollywood. item.title: Congratulations to 38th Caucus Foundation Winner, Kathryn Boyd-Batstone
item.description: We want to congratulate Kathryn Boyd-Batstone from USC, a 2020 Caucus Foundation award winner! Kathryn has received a $30,000 grant to be used for production and post-production services here at Illuminate Hollywood. Kathryn, we look forward to working with you in the future! The post Congratulations to 38th Caucus Foundation Winner, Kathryn Boyd-Batstone first appeared on Illuminate Hollywood.

item.title: Celebrating 26 Years!
item.description: 26 years ago, illuminate Hollywood opened its doors and joined the entertainment world!
